title: Flash backup 10.1 - U7's two cJTAG test points, and the pins they ring to
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~104 px/mm in this crop)
caption: TP13 carries U7's TMSC (pin 24), TP14 its TCKC (pin 25): the XDS110's TMS and TCK go there and nowhere else on U7; its GND goes to JP5 pin 2 (picture 7.1). The beeper checks each pair first (dotted). U7 sits turned 180 degrees: its pin-1 dot is bottom right, so pins 24 and 25 meet at the top-left corner.

callouts.label: = TMSC (U7 pin 24): the XDS110's TMS
callouts.note: Traced on the mosaic: up and along the top edge to U7's top-row corner pin (J-228). Beeper, unpowered: TP13 to pin 24 beeps; TP13 to TP14 and to GND nothing (raptox, 2026-11-06, J-230).

callouts.label: = TCKC (U7 pin 25): the XDS110's TCK
callouts.note: Traced on the mosaic: right and down to the top pin of U7's left row (J-228). Beeper, unpowered: TP14 to pin 25 beeps; to GND nothing (raptox, 2026-11-06, J-230).

callouts.label: TMSC: the beeper's other end for TP13
callouts.note: JTAG_TMSC is pin 24 (SWRS204C p. 8, confirmed); its place, the leftmost pin of the top row, follows from the pin-1 dot (8) and the counter-clockwise numbering. Beeper, unpowered: pin 24 to TP13 beeps, to GND nothing (raptox, J-230).

callouts.label: TCKC: the beeper's other end for TP14
callouts.note: JTAG_TCKC is pin 25 (SWRS204C p. 8, confirmed); the top pin of the left row. Beeper, unpowered: pin 25 to TP14 beeps, to GND nothing (raptox, J-230).

callouts.label: = TDO (U7 pin 26): no lead
callouts.note: Traced to the second pin of the left row (DIO_16/JTAG_TDO). Four-wire JTAG only; 2-pin cJTAG doesn't use it.

callouts.label: = TDI (U7 pin 27): no lead
callouts.note: Traced to the third pin of the left row (DIO_17/JTAG_TDI). Not used by 2-pin cJTAG.

callouts.label: RESET_N: no lead (fallback only, 10.7)
callouts.note: No internal pull-up (SWRS204C p. 9); its trace runs down to an R/C pair under U7, no test point found. Needed only if the connect fails.

callouts.label: pin 1: the chip sits turned 180 degrees
callouts.note: The marking reads upside down in this view and the dot sits bottom right: pin 1 is there, pins 1-12 run up the right row, 13-24 right to left along the top, 25-36 down the left row. The RF pins (1, 2) face FL1 and the 32 kHz pins Y1, as they should.

callouts.label: no lead (a DIO, not traced)
callouts.note: Runs to one of the top row's middle pins (a DIO); not traced exactly. Not part of the debug port.
